title: Which Nights the Nightly Departure Elements of a Resort Lodging Stay Run Over
content:
The nights the nightly elements of a Resort Lodging departure services charge are worked out over follow the records of the stay.

Where the folio shows the party occupied every night the reservation covers, they are worked out over every night the reservation covers.

Where the folio shows the party occupied fewer nights than the reservation covers and a departure is recorded on the reservation, they are worked out over every night from the arrival date to the recorded departure, because a unit the party has not given back is a unit the collective cannot let.

In every other case they are worked out over the nights the folio shows consumed.

| What the records of the stay show | The nights the nightly elements run over |
| --- | --- |
| The folio shows the party occupied every night the reservation covers | every night the reservation covers |
| Fewer nights consumed than the reservation covers, and a departure recorded | every night from the arrival date to the recorded departure |
| Any other case | the nights the folio shows consumed |

### Three hypothetical stays on a reservation covering 7 nights

A folio showing 7 nights consumed shows the party occupied every night the reservation covers, so the nightly elements run over those 7 nights.

A folio showing 3 nights consumed, on a reservation carrying a recorded departure 5 nights after the arrival date, shows fewer nights consumed than the reservation covers, so the nightly elements run over the 5 nights from the arrival date to the recorded departure.

A folio showing 3 nights consumed on a reservation carrying no recorded departure falls into neither of the first two, so the nightly elements run over the 3 nights the folio shows consumed.
